verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's first-party pages say it is 'one agent that resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS' and that it works 'via phone, SMS, chat, email, and WhatsApp'. That implies the same agent, knowledge and actions apply on phone calls as in chat. The evidence is only brief marketing statements with no voice-specific documentation. Missing for 10: details on speech-to-text and text-to-speech handling, telephony/phone-number integration, voice-specific confirmation that chat workflows and actions carry over, and independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.
